verdict.rationale: The Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, a hardware component with no data-analysis interface of its own, so in-product AI-generated insights from user data is a category error. The marketing line about being a 'gateway to AI experiences' and the link to Ryzen AI developer software describe running AI workloads on the chip, not a feature that analyzes the user's data. Ryzen Master's real-time monitoring and Auto Overclock are tuning tools, not AI suggestions, so the axis still does not apply.
